mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_chat_message ( chat_message_seq, chat_room_seq, sender_seq, content, regdate ) VALUES ( #{messageId}, #{chatRoomSeq}, #{senderSeq}, #{content}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select:
SELECT m.chat_message_seq AS "messageId", m.chat_room_seq AS "chatRoomSeq", m.sender_seq AS "senderSeq", m.content AS "content", TO_CHAR(m.regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "createdAt", ( SELECT MAX(a.attachment_seq) FROM tbl_chat_attachment a WHERE a.chat_message_seq = m.chat_message_seq ) AS "attachmentSeq", ( SELECT MAX(a.content_type) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY a.attachment_seq) FROM tbl_chat_attachment a WHERE a.chat_message_seq = m.chat_message_seq ) AS "attachmentContentType"
FROM tbl_chat_message m WHERE m.chat_message_seq = #{messageId}

SELECT m.chat_message_seq AS "messageId", m.chat_room_seq AS "chatRoomSeq", m.sender_seq AS "senderSeq", m.content AS "content", TO_CHAR(m.regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "createdAt", ( SELECT MAX(a.attachment_seq) FROM tbl_chat_attachment a WHERE a.chat_message_seq = m.chat_message_seq ) AS "attachmentSeq", ( SELECT MAX(a.content_type) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY a.attachment_seq) FROM tbl_chat_attachment a WHERE a.chat_message_seq = m.chat_message_seq ) AS "attachmentContentType"
FROM tbl_chat_message m WHERE m.chat_room_seq = #{roomId} ORDER BY m.chat_message_seq ASC
